lines.japanese:
チチ、チチチ、チチチチチ
　……窓が開けっぱなしになっているんだろうか。
　庭のほうから小鳥の鳴き声が聞こえてきている。
　ひんやりと冷たい風が頬にあたる。
　目蓋には淡い陽の光。
　静かで、ゆるやかな周囲の色合い。
　柔らかな朝の訪れ。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
Chirp, chirrup, chirrup-chirrup
Had the window been left open?
Small birds were calling from the garden.
A cool breeze brushed my cheek.
Pale sunlight lay against my eyelids.
The world around me was quiet, its colors soft and slow.
Morning arrived gently.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Tweet, Tweet, Tweet
…… Is the window open?
I can hear the soft singing of birds from the garden.
A cool breeze blows across my face.
I feel the sunlight hitting my eyelids.
A quiet, gentle atmosphere.
A gentle morning.

lines.japanese:
朝、か。
　昨夜、秋葉に看病されたまま眠って、そのまま朝を迎えてしまったらしい。
　体はベッドに横になったままで、体のふしぶしが微かに重かった。
　それでも昨夜よりは体は回復している。
　目を開けて、体を起こす事にした。
　と――――
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
Morning, huh.
I must have fallen asleep while Akiha was tending me last night and slept straight through until dawn.
I was still lying in bed, my joints faintly heavy.
Even so, I felt better than I had the night before.
I decided to open my eyes and sit up.
And then—

「あ。
やっと起きたな、こいつめ」
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish: “Oh. Look who finally woke up.”
lines.mao_english: “Oh. Look who finally woke up.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah.
The little rascal finally woke up."
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ah.

lines.japanese: ――――目の前には、アルクェイドの顔があった。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish: ――――Arcueid’s face was right in front of mine.
lines.mao_english: ――――Arcueid’s face was right in front of mine.
lines.mirrorMoon: …… I see Arcueid's face right in front of mine.
lines.mirror_moon: …… I see Arcueid's face right in front of mine.

lines.japanese:
「――――――！？」
　あまりの出来事に、頭は真っ白になってろくに働いてくれない。
　口はぱくぱくと正体不明の声を出している。
―――本気で、事態がどうなっているのかわからない。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“—!?”
My mind went white, too overwhelmed to function.
My mouth opened and closed, producing sounds no one could have identified.
―――I honestly had no idea what was happening.
lines.mao_english:
“—!?”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"………!?"
My brain goes blank and stops working due to this unexpected event.
My mouth opens and closes, but my voice seems to be missing.
---Seriously, what's going on?
lines.mirror_moon:
"………!?"

lines.japanese:
ただ目前にはアルクェイドがいて、
　ここは自分の部屋で、
　時刻はちょうど朝の九時すぎで、
　おまけにアルクェイドは土足であがりこんでいるって事ぐらいしか分からない。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
All I could grasp was that Arcueid was in front of me,
that this was my room, that it was a little past nine in the morning—and,
to make matters worse,
that Arcueid had come inside without taking off her shoes.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Arcueid is in front of me.
This is my room.
It's past nine o'clock in the morning,
She's come inside, still wearing her shoes; that's all I know for now.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「お、お、お、ま、え」
「うそつき。
また明日って約束したのに」
　かなりご機嫌ななめなのか、アルクェイドの赤い瞳は本来の美しさを損ねている。
―――いや、損ねてなんかいないか。
　こんなに間近で見てしまっている分、むしろ普段より鮮明に、美しいと感じられる。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Y-you—you…”
“Liar. You promised you’d see me tomorrow.”
Arcueid must have been in a foul mood; indignation clouded the usual beauty of her red eyes.
―――No, it didn’t.
At this distance, if anything, her beauty was only sharper and more vivid than usual.

lines.japanese:
じぃぃい、とアルクェイドは横になったままの俺をにらんでいる。
「―――ちょっ、ちょっと待てアルクェイド。
どうして、どうしておまえが朝から俺の部屋にいるんだ……！」
　怒鳴ろうとして、声を極力小さくした。
　ここで大声を出して翡翠が部屋にやってきたら、それこそ終わりだ。
―――状況は依然として混沌としたままだけど、それぐらいの理性はちゃんと働いてくれている。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
Arcueid fixed me with a long, smoldering glare as I lay there.
“W-wait a second, Arcueid. Why—why are you in my room this early in the morning…!”
I nearly shouted, then forced my voice as low as it would go.
If Hisui heard me and came in now, it would all be over.
―――The situation was still pure chaos, but at least that much of my reason remained intact.

"…… W-Wait, Arcueid.

I start to shout, but I stop myself.
If I shouted now, Hisui would come here and it would all be over.
---Everything is still chaotic, but my brain can grasp that much.

lines.japanese:
「と、とにかくどいてくれ……！
　人の部屋にかってにあがって、眠ってる人間を脅かすなんてサイテーだってわかってるのか……！？」
「なによ、その態度。
わたしがこんなところにやってきたのは、志貴が約束を破ったからでしょ。
人のことを待たせておいて自分はずっと眠ってるなんて、いったいどういうつもりなのよ」
　むーっ、と不機嫌そうにアルクェイドは俺を睨む。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“J-just get off me…! You barge into someone’s room and scare him awake—do you have any idea how awful that is…!?”
“What’s with that attitude? I only came here because you broke your promise. You left me waiting while you slept—what did you think you were doing?”
Arcueid glared at me, cheeks practically puffed with displeasure.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"A-Anyway, move……!
Just going into someone's room, threatening a sleeping person, don't you know how awful that is……!?"
"What's with that attitude?
I came here because you broke your promise.
Sleeping while making someone wait, just what in the world were you planning?"
She stares at me ill-temperedly.

……ちょっと、冷静に考えてみる。
　っと、そうか。
昨夜のアルクェイドとの待ち合わせを、俺は破ってしまったんだっけ。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
All right—think calmly.
Oh, right. I had missed my meeting with Arcueid last night.
lines.mao_english:

That's right.
I really did break my promise to meet Arcueid last night.

「――――む」
　ようやく事情が飲み込めた。
　アルクェイドが怒っている理由はわかった。
　わかったけど、それにしたって―――土足で人の部屋にやってくるのはどういう了見なんだろうか、こいつはっ。
　窓が開けっぱなしというところを見ると、どうにもそこから忍び込んできたみたいだし。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
At last I understood.
I knew why Arcueid was angry.
Even so—what kind of lunatic climbed into another person’s room with her shoes on?
Judging by the open window, that was apparently how she had sneaked inside.

I finally understand the situation.
I understand why Arcueid's angry.
I understand, but to do this… to come into someone's room still wearing shoes like that, what does she intend to do?
Seeing that the window is open, she probably came in through there.

lines.japanese:
「……そうか、約束を破ったんだから、そりゃあ確かにこっちが悪い。
けど、そんな事でひとんちに侵入するのはやりすぎだぞ」
「ここ、志貴の家じゃないわ」
　アルクェイドはきっぱりと言い返してくる。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Fine, I broke my promise, so I was in the wrong. But breaking into someone’s house over it is going way too far.”
“This isn’t your house.”
Arcueid shot the correction back without hesitation.

lines.japanese:
「それにね、ほんとはわたし、もっと怒ってたんだから。
何時間も待ち惚けで、約束を反古にされたんだって気づいた時は自分でも驚くぐらいに頭に血がのぼったわ。
　もう、絶対にこのままじゃすまさない、乗り込んでいって志貴の首根っこぐらい引き千切ってやるって思ったぐらい」
　むっとした瞳のまま、アルクェイドは淡々と語る。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Besides, I was much angrier before. I waited for hours, and when I finally realized you weren’t coming, I got so furious I surprised even myself.
I swore I wasn’t going to let you get away with it—that I’d march in here and tear your head off by the roots.”
Her eyes still sulking, Arcueid delivered this account in an utterly matter-of-fact tone.

I waited for many hours, and as soon as I realized you weren't coming, I got so incredibly angry.
I was thinking I would never let this happen again and I'd rip your throat out."
She speaks, still looking ill-tempered.

「わかる、志貴？
　ああいう気持ちってね、たまらないのよ。
自分でも冷静になろうって思うんだけど、思えば思うほど頭にきちゃうような泥沼なんだから」
　今でもそういう気分なのか、アルクェイドの赤い瞳は俺に対して非難の色を示している。
「ああ―――たしかにたまらないな、それは」
　自分の首が無事なのをかみさまに感謝しながら、そんな相づちをうった。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“You understand, Shiki? It’s unbearable. You tell yourself to calm down, but the harder you try, the angrier you get—it just drags you deeper.”
Perhaps she still felt that way; accusation remained bright in her red eyes.
“Yeah—that does sound unbearable.”
I nodded along while privately thanking God that my neck was still attached.

"Yeah… I guess you can't help yourself."
Giving thanks to God my neck is still attached, I keep the conversation going.

「でしょ？
　そうしてここに忍び込んだんだけど、志貴が眠ってるから待ってあげる事にしたのよ。
言い訳ぐらいは聞いてみたかったから。
　で、やる事もなかったし、しばらく貴方の寝顔を見てた。
……うん、志貴の寝顔はね、恐いくらい、静かだった。
　死んでいるみたいに眠っていて、もう起き上がる事はないんじゃないかって不安になったぐらい」
「……はあ。
不安だったら起こしてくれればよかったのに。
こっちはおまえに横にいられるほうがよっぽど不安だ」
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Right? So I sneaked in here, but you were asleep, and I decided to wait. I wanted to hear your excuse, at least.
I had nothing else to do, so I watched you sleeping for a while. You know, Shiki, your face was almost frighteningly peaceful.
You slept so much like the dead that I began to worry you might never wake up.”
“…If you were worried, you could’ve woken me. Having you beside me was much more alarming.”
lines.mao_english:

You slept so much like the dead that I began to worry you might never wake up.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Isn't it?
And I snuck in here, but since you were sleeping I decided to wait.
At least I wanted to hear your excuse.
And, since I didn't have anything to do, I watched your sleeping face.
…… Yeah, your sleeping face was very quiet, it was almost scary.
Sleeping like you were dead, I started feeling uneasy because I thought that maybe you would never wake up."
I sigh.
"If you were uneasy then you should've woke me.
I'm uneasy when you're next to me."

　……わたし、自分の眠っている姿はしらないけど、志貴みたいに眠れるのなら幸せかもしれないなって。
　どうして志貴はこんなに穏やかなんだろうって、ずっと考えながら見つめてた。
　そうしていたらね、あれだけ怒っていた気持ちも収まっていて、そのあとに志貴が目を覚ましたの」
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“But it seemed such a waste to wake you.
I don’t know what I look like asleep, but I thought that if I could sleep the way you do, maybe that would be happiness.
I kept watching you, wondering how you could look so peaceful.
After a while all that anger faded away—and then you woke up.”

何度か家の人がやってきたけど、見つからないようにしておいたから大丈夫よ。

　あはは、とアルクェイドは能天気に笑う。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“You mean you’ve been sitting there since last night?”
“Yes. People from the house came in a few times, but I made sure they didn’t find me.
A woman came to wake you a little while ago, too, but I didn’t like her, so I sent her away.”
Arcueid laughed without a care in the world.

「手荒なまねはしてないわ。
ほら、前に吸血鬼には魅了の魔眼があるって言ったでしょ？
　あの女の人には『志貴はもう学校に行った』って暗示をかけて追い返しただけだから、わたしの事も記憶に残ってないよ」
「記憶に残ってないよって、おまえね……」
　ほんと、なんてはた迷惑なヤツなんだ。
　……まあ、それでもはた迷惑なヤツははた迷惑なヤツなりに、こっちの家庭環境に対して気を使ってくれてるみたいだけど。
lines.label: s162
lines.maoEnglish:
“Wait—what do you mean, sent her away?”
“I didn’t hurt her. Remember when I told you vampires possess Mystic Eyes of Enchantment? I merely planted the suggestion that ‘Shiki has already left for school’ and sent her away, so she won’t remember me either.”
“You say that like it makes everything fine…”
Honestly, what a spectacular nuisance.
Even so, this spectacular nuisance appeared to be making some allowance for my situation at home.

“See you tonight. If the same thing happens again, I’ll kill you.”
Arcueid disappeared after delivering an entirely sincere threat in a joking voice.
She leaped through the window and bounded from branch to branch.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Arcueid asks whether Shiki has reflected on his wrongdoing, and he says he has because he now understands how frightening her retaliation is. “That is part of it, I suppose, but the police are an institution of human law. Creatures like us don’t take them into account.
Still, you are right that vampires erase their traces to protect themselves.”

This is true of other transcendent species as well, but revealing their existence is especially fatal for the vampiric species.
A vampire might take over some tiny mountain village cut off from civilization and build a secret kingdom there, but once enough victims accumulate, ‘they’ will inevitably catch the scent.”

lines.maoEnglish:
“Vampires prey on humans in secret for one reason alone: self-preservation.
They hide the bodies not because they fear public rumor, but because they don’t want their natural enemy finding them.”
“Wonderful. Now there’s some other incomprehensible monster that even vampires are afraid of.”
Speaking as an ordinary human, I’d really prefer no more violations of common sense to come barging into my life.

lines.japanese:
「何いってるのよ。
その天敵っていうのはあなたたち人間の事じゃない」
「────？
　天敵って、俺たちが？」
「そう。
もうずっと昔、人間は様々な魔術、神秘学、式典儀礼をもとに組織体系を作り、人間以外の霊長類を排除しはじめたの。
　その最たる物が基督教───法王庁が誇るエクシシストの集団よ。
旧教（カトリック）は昔っから『人間でないモノ』を徹底的に淘汰してきたけど、その中でも吸血鬼に対する敵視はどうかしてるわ」
lines.label: s173
lines.maoEnglish:
“What are you talking about? Their natural enemy is humanity.”
“What? We are the natural enemy?”
“Yes. Long ago, humans built organizations upon magecraft, mysticism, and ceremonial rites, then began exterminating every primate that wasn’t human.
The foremost example is Christianity—the exorcist order of which the Holy See is so proud. The Catholic Church has always ruthlessly purged ‘things that are not human,’ but even by those standards, its hatred of vampires is deranged.”

The foremost example is Christianity—the exorcist order of which the Holy See is so proud. The Catholic Church has always ruthlessly purged ‘things that are not human,’ but even by those standards, its hatred of vampires is deranged.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"What are you saying?
Their natural enemy is without a doubt you humans."
"-----?
Natural enemies, us?"
"Yeah.
Starting from a long time ago, humans used many kinds of magic, the occult, magical ceremonies to create an organization and started to eliminate primates other than humans.
The greatest of these is Christianity---the pride of the Vatican, the Exorcists.
The Catholic Church always viewed "nonhumans" as impurities, but vampires are considered the most dangerous."

They’re called the Burial Agency. When Christianity runs into a contradiction, they settle it with force instead of law—exorcists who work like assassins and never show themselves in public.”
“……”
A priest who killed vampires.
The image fit so perfectly that I had nothing to say.

“What—?”
Of all Arcueid’s questions, this was the hardest to fathom.

Eight years ago, I nearly died.
For a little while—probably while the doctors were treating me in the operating room—I felt as though I had been in a place of absolute darkness.
Perhaps it had only been a dream.
But at the time, I felt certain I had died, and I believed that place itself was death.
Then I survived by a miracle, met my teacher, and returned to an ordinary life; the joy of that return had been overwhelming.

Arcueid nodded and smiled as if to say, “Right?”

Until we defeated the vampire.
“…Right.
That was the relationship we had.”
Today had been so ordinary that I had completely forgotten that fundamental truth.

“I will. But once I’ve recovered, we’re heading into town, Arcueid.”
“Honestly. I’m glad you’re so eager, but it’s much too early.
Nrvnqsr was the same—vampires don’t stir without good reason until their own hours arrive.
They won’t become active until the night has deepened, so we’ll have to kill some time here.”
“…”
That was something I would have appreciated hearing much sooner.
―――I sat on a bench with nothing to do but watch the clock.
The park clock had crept past nine.
The figures around us gradually thinned away as the night steadily deepened.
For some reason Arcueid refused to sit and wandered about nearby with an air of restless boredom.

“What—? We’re their natural enemy?”
“Yes. Long ago, humans built organized systems around magecraft, occult learning, and ceremonial rites, then began eliminating nonhuman primates.
The foremost example is Christianity—the Holy See’s vaunted order of exorcists. The old Catholic Church has always exterminated anything ‘nonhuman’ without mercy, but its hatred of vampires is deranged even by those standards.”

They are so insane, I don't even want to mess with them."
Arcueid lets out a sigh.

lines.japanese:
はあ、とため息をついて公園を見渡す。
　……一ヶ月前。
　この街に連続殺人なんて事件さえ起きなければ、この時間でもここには若いカップルだの、夜遊びから帰る途中の学生やらの姿があったのに。
　今では、こうして話してしているのは自分とアルクェイドだけだ。
　ふと、冷静に自分の置かれた位置というヤツを省みる。
　一体いつから、遠野志貴は、こんな日常に足を踏み入れてしまってたんだろう―――？
lines.label: s178
lines.maoEnglish:
I sigh and survey the park.
One month ago.
Before the serial killings began, there would still have been young couples here at this hour, along with students returning from a night out.
Now Arcueid and I are the only ones left talking.
For one clear moment, I consider where I've ended up.
When did Shiki Tohno ever step into a life like this—?

That idiot―――she really is fighting alone, even in that condition…!
“―――Found you…!”
Forgetting both fatigue and pain, I race toward the alley.

lines.japanese:
路地裏の入り口。
　ビルとビルの間にある細い道を走っていく。
『死』は、パチンパチンと弾けては消えていく。
　……よっぽど多くの死者と戦っているのか、この量は異常だ。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
The mouth of the alley.
I run down the narrow passage between the buildings.
‘Death’ keeps bursting with sharp little snaps, then vanishing.
There are far too many; she must be fighting a horde of the Dead.
lines.mao_english:

‘Death’ keeps bursting with sharp little snaps, then vanishing.

lines.mirrorMoon:
The entrance to the alley.
I run to the narrow path between the buildings.
"Death" is flying through the air and fading away.
…… How many is she fighting?
There's an enormous amount of it.
lines.mirror_moon:
The entrance to the alley.
I run to the narrow path between the buildings.
"Death" is flying through the air and fading away.

lines.japanese:
「――――――くっ」
　耐えられないのは。
　路地裏に近づくたびに、ぎっ、ぎっ、と音をたてる背骨の軋みだった。
「はっ―――――あ」
　まるで、ノコギリで少しずつ骨を切断されていくよう。
　それは自分自身が出している痛みだ。
　本能が叫んでいる。
　この先に行くのは危険だから今すぐひき返せ、と。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――Ngh.”
What I cannot bear.
It is the creaking of my spine, growing louder with every step toward the alley.
“Hah―――――ah.”
It feels as though a saw is cutting slowly through my bones.
The pain comes from within me.
My instincts scream.
Danger lies ahead; turn back now.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"------Gh."
I can hardly bear it.
As I run to the alley, my spine groans in protest.
"Ha------agh."
As if a saw was slowly but surely slicing through my spine,
a pain works its way from inside me.
My instincts scream at me.
They say where I'm going is too dangerous, and I have to go back.

「うる―――さい」
　でも、そんなコトは言われなくてもわかっている。
　この死の量は尋常じゃない。
　この奥。
路地裏で、なにか、ヤバイ事が起きているのはわかっている。
　けど、今更引き返せない。
　アルクェイドを放っておけない。
　もし―――ここで自分が逃げ帰ったら、あいつは勝手に死んでしまう。
　そんな予感がどうしても消えてくれなくて、自分から死が充満する路地裏へ足を踏み入れた。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shut―――up.”
I don’t need instinct to tell me.
This much death is not normal.
Deeper in the alley. Something terrible is happening there.
But I can’t turn back now.
I can’t abandon Arcueid.
If I run home from here, she will go and die on her own.
Unable to shake that premonition, I step willingly into the alley saturated with death.

Inside.

But I can't turn back now.

「な――――――」
　意識が、凍りついた。
　そこに広がっている光景は、マトモじゃなかった。
　地面に転がっている、何人ものヒトの形。
　顔がなく、腕も潰され、はらわたを引き裂かれ、全身を真っ赤な色に染めた死体たち。
　壁も、床も、ともすれば頭上の月さえも。
　ここでは、ただ、赤かった。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
“Wha――――――”
My consciousness freezes.
There is nothing sane about the scene spread before me.
Human shapes lie scattered across the ground.
Faceless corpses with crushed arms and torn-open entrails, every inch of them dyed scarlet.
The walls, the pavement—perhaps even the moon overhead.
Here, everything is simply red.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Wha------"
My mind freezes.
What I see is surreal.
Scattered all across the ground are the figures of numerous people.
Faceless, limbless, their stomachs sliced open, the corpses bathed entirely in crimson.
On the wall, the ground, even on the moon overhead.
Everything here is just… red.

ずしゃ、という鈍い音。
　最後の一人だったのか、全身をラクガキに塗りつぶされたヒトガタは、彼女の手によって絶命した。
　片手で。
　死者の頭を壁に叩きつけて、トマトみたいに潰してしまう。
　それでも飽き足らないのか、彼女は頭のない死体の体を縦に引き裂いて、そのまま路面に打ち付けた。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
A wet, heavy sound.
Perhaps it is the last one: the humanoid figure blackened with scribbles dies at her hands.
With one hand.
She smashes the Dead man’s skull against the wall and crushes it like a tomato.
As though that still cannot satisfy her, she tears the headless body apart lengthwise and slams it into the pavement.

As if not satisfied, she tears the headless body vertically in half and smashes it onto the ground.

　月の明かりと赤だけの世界。
　その中心にアルクェイドがいた。
　彼女はこちらに気がついていない。
　ただ月を見上げて―――恍惚と、荒い呼吸をくり返している。

“Arc―――ueid.”
A world made only of moonlight and red.
Arcueid stands at its center.
She has not noticed me.
She merely gazes up at the moon, breathing hard in ecstasy.

lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
I cannot call to her.
The grinding in my spine has reached its peak.
The saw feels as though it has already severed the bone.
lines.mao_english:

The pain inside me reaches a feverish pitch.
It seems like the saw has cut all the way through.

――――ぎ、ぎ。

自分はまだ死にたくない、と叫んでいる。

　目が合ったわけではない。
　ただ、俺が、その『眼』を見てしまったというだけ。
lines.label: s180

――――Creak, creak.
My consciousness screams.
It screams that I must not stay here. That I do not want to die yet.
At that moment.
Arcueid’s eyes swivel toward me.
Arcueid's eyes are not red, but gold.
Our gazes do not meet.
I have merely looked upon that ‘eye.’

Arcueid's eyes suddenly shift.

It's not that our eyes have met.
It's just that I looked at those "eyes".

lines.label: s180

Every drop of blood in my body surges, and my consciousness blanks out.
―――First comes an overwhelming sense of danger.

My blood races through my entire body and my mind is jolted.
----At first, a sense of overwhelming crisis.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
ここにいてはいけない。
　アレの前にいてはいけない。
　　　コロサレル。
　　　カナイッコナイ。
　あの『生き物』はレヴェルが違う。
　レヴェルが高い低いというのではなく、レヴェルという判断基準そのものが自分たちとは違いすぎる。
　アレの前では、ただ――――そこにいるだけで間違いなく殺される。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
I must not remain here.
I must not stand before that thing.
IT WILL KILL ME.
I CAN NEVER WIN.
That ‘creature’ exists on another level.
It is not a matter of higher or lower; the very scale by which its existence is measured is utterly different from ours.
Before that thing, simply by standing here, I will unquestionably be killed.

IT WILL KILL YOU.
YOU CAN'T STAND UP TO IT.

Before that thing----just being there means death.

　その次に来たものは、完全なまでの殺意。
　なぜなら、アレはいてはいけないものだ。
　だから殺せ。
はやく殺せ。
ここで殺せ。
すぐに殺せ。
　この血の脈動にかけて、
　アレを、
　この場で破壊しろ―――――

Every blood vessel in my body swells.
First comes fear.
What follows is absolute murderous intent.
That thing must not exist.
So kill it. Kill it quickly. Kill it here. Kill it now.
On the pulse of this blood—
that thing—
destroy it here and now—

心臓が跳ね上がる。
　敵いっこないとわかっているのに、殺せと全身が鳴動している。
　なんて矛盾―――殺されるとわかっているのに殺せというのか。
　死にたくないから殺せというのに、この場にとどまって殺されろというのか。
lines.label: s180
lines.maoEnglish:
My heart leaps.
Though I know I cannot win, my whole body roars at me to kill.
What a contradiction—I know it will kill me, yet I’m commanded to kill it.
The voice says kill because I don’t want to die, yet it also commands me to remain here and be killed.

　アルクェイドが走り去っていった理由を考察し、彼女は何故、何処へ、何をしに行ったのか、と推理をめぐらせていけば答えはおのずと出てきます。

To be perfectly blunt, Tohno has no idea how to look for someone.
Think about why Arcueid ran off—why she left, where she went, and what she meant to do—and the answer will reveal itself.
In short, she got hungry and went into an alley for a little sip-sip!
